Item: Have you identified and finalized the list of templates/themes?
Have you identified the list of blocks needed?
Have you mapped usable blocks from block library?
Is the block library plugin configured?
Are environment secrets used to store passwords/tokens or secrets?
Have you configured environment variables for environment-specific values?
Have reasonable connect and read timeouts been set for outgoing HTTP connections?
Are form authoring aspects/requirements taken into consideration?
Is lazy loading implemented for fragments?
Is DOR (Deferred Object Rendering) capability used and validated?
Are HTTP error codes and API status codes handled for REST API invocations?
Are user interactions frozen while back-end transactions are in progress?
Are placeholders configured for custom blocks to use static strings?
Are unit test scripts (Cypress) created for blocks?
Are there any product defects identified? Are Jira tickets created and assigned?
Are there any components/artifacts developed worth adding to the product?
Are there any components/artifacts developed worth sharing with other projects?
Are all fonts, images, and styles served from the application and not referring to third-party resources?
Are code/implementation reviews conducted regularly?
Have all blocker/critical/major code quality issues been resolved?
Does the project meet the intended code coverage criteria?
Do team members have code quality check tools like JS Lint installed locally for pre-PR checks?
Are any custom query indexes created?
Are accessibility/usability requirements handled in implementation?
Are developer best practices followed?
Have you updated vanity URLs?
Are metadata configured for pages (page level / site level)?
Is sitemap.xml configured?
Is robots.txt configured to skip crawling pages from non-prod environments?
Is indexing optimized and maintained as per customer requirements?
Is index definition made part of code base?
Is content automation utilized in the project?
Are third-party systems accessing assets from EDS? If yes, how?
Are SCoE portal tools used? If yes, list them; if no, explain why not utilized?
Is code branching strategy documented and followed?
Is a review workflow being used? OOTB or custom?
Are reusable components implemented in a modular and track-independent way?
Are shared front-end and back-end APIs reused across tracks?
Are common error handling, logging, and monitoring mechanisms implemented for shared modules?
Are automated tests written in a reusable way to support multiple tracks?
Ensure the site is accessible via keyboard shortcuts
Check compatibility with screen readers
Are indexes created and optimized for production?
Are code quality and code coverage criteria met?
Is the CDN configured considering security non-functional requirements?
Has approval been received for accessibility and usability validations?
Passed security audits?
Is system monitoring configured for production?
Are maintenance routines configured for production?
Are all access privileges reviewed and limited to only required personnel?
Are vulnerability scans conducted for production environment before GoLive?
Are critical/major code quality issues resolved before GoLive?
Are load and stress testing results documented and approved?
Are security monitoring tools validated for production?
Are granted permissions on the production system revoked/limited post-deployment and sanity checks?
Are there any security alerts post-deployment? Are these issues prioritized and ETA on closure provided?
Are there any performance issues reported? Is RCA provided? Is ETA on closure provided?
Are security logs monitored and reviewed for post-GoLive period?
Are incident response procedures defined and validated for production?
Are load balancing, CDN, and caching mechanisms monitored and optimized post-GoLive?
Are monitoring alerts configured for SLA violations?
Are SSL/TLS certificates monitored and renewed before expiry?
Are performance metrics (response time, throughput, error rates) reported periodically?
Are penetration tests or security scans planned post-GoLive?
Are vulnerabilities prioritized and mitigation plans implemented promptly?
Is post-GoLive capacity planning reviewed for future scaling?
